newsitem.title: ITALY: New Venetian air cargo logistics company.
newsitem.headline: New Venetian air cargo logistics company.

text.p: Air Cargo Venice Srl has been formed to provide logistics support and air cargo services for the Venetian region, the company said in a statement.
Backers of the new venture are Italian road haulage concern, Freschi & Schiavoni and the Centro Intermodale Adriatico Spa at Porto Marghera, it added.
The new concern is headquartered at Centro Intermodale and the latter's managing director, Silvano Causin, is president of Air Cargo Venice.
